title: Complete and simulate a mass-spring-damper in OpenModelica
skills_assessed: Reading 1D step-response KPIs (steady state, peak, damping class)
before_you_start: OpenModelica (omc), OMEdit, and the Modelica Standard Library are on the desktop.
The stubbed Plant.mo, simulate.mos, and notes are on the desktop. From that folder: omc simulate.mos

role.title: Model-based systems / simulation engineer
role.company_context: Product company that ships 1D plant models in Modelica next to controls and test rigs. A small simulation team owns OpenModelica models so mechanical and controls engineers can share the same translational plant instead of maintaining ad-hoc MATLAB scripts. Hiring to strengthen day-to-day Modelica modeling and OpenModelica simulation on that team.
day_to_day: Complete and review Modelica models that use Modelica Standard Library mechanical components
Wire acausal connect equations for 1D translational plants (mass, spring, damper, force)
Simulate in OpenModelica (omc or OMEdit) and extract steady-state and transient KPIs from the result
Keep parameter sets and initial conditions stable so QA can rerun the same experiment
Pair with mechanical engineers on “the diagram simulates but the numbers look wrong” issues
required_skills: Comfortable writing Modelica connect equations for MSL Translational components
Can distinguish parallel vs series spring-damper topology in 1D
Can run a model in OpenModelica (omc script or OMEdit) and read a plotted trajectory
Understands second-order step response: steady state F/k, damping ratio, peak overshoot
nice_to_have_skills: Familiarity with OMEdit diagram view and result files (*_res.mat)
Prior work on test-rig, actuator, or isolation-mount plant models
Comfort reading omc translation errors when a connect is missing
constraints: Assessment focuses on completing the provided OpenModelica translational plant — not redesigning the stack or adding 3D MultiBody, FMI export, or a controls controller
Do not test Dymola licenses, MATLAB/Simulink, or commercial Modelica libraries in this challenge
Candidate works in a desktop environment with Terminal, OpenModelica, OMEdit, and VS Code available
Starter files on the desktop are shared scenery; do not require inventing a different physical domain

rubric.name: Working OpenModelica simulation
rubric.summary: Demonstrates a successful omc or OMEdit simulate of the leftover Plant.mo.
rubric.description: YES/NO: Did the candidate demonstrate a successful OpenModelica simulation (omc simulate.mos or OMEdit Simulate) of the leftover Plant.mo through the instance stopTime? Answer YES only if video or narrative shows a completed translation/simulation (no still-empty equation section, no unresolved simulation error). Spreadsheet-only, Python-only, compile-only with no run, or inferred “probably works” = NO. YES = full points; NO or unclear = 0.

rubric.name: Correct step-response KPIs
rubric.summary: Reports instance s_ss, s_peak, and underdamped classification.
rubric.description: YES/NO: Do leftover KPIs match the instance keys? s_ss must equal F/k for the instance parameters in notes.md / brief (within ±0.01 m or ±3%). s_peak must match the instance underdamped overshoot of mass.s (same band). Damping class must be underdamped. Answer YES only if all three match the instance table, not skeleton-only 0.200 / 0.305 when this instance differs. Wrong bundle, mm/m mixup, or missing peak = NO. YES = full points; NO or unclear = 0.

rubric.name: Parallel spring-damper topology
rubric.summary: Uses the MSL translational plant with spring and damper in parallel and force on the mass.
rubric.description: YES/NO: Does leftover Plant.mo (or equivalent equations) implement spring and damper in parallel between the wall and the mass, with the constant force acting on the mass, using the declared MSL translational components or the equivalent 1D ODE m s̈ + d ṡ + k s = F? Answer YES only if that topology is visible. Series spring-damper, force on the wall only, or a different physical system (electrical RLC, extra masses) = NO. Flange_a/flange_b swaps on two-port elements are OK. YES = full points; NO or unclear = 0.

rubric.name: Clarity of deliverables
rubric.summary: Leaves a simulatable Plant.mo and labeled KPIs a reviewer can follow without guessing.
rubric.description: YES/NO: Is there a leftover Plant.mo plus a labeled s_ss / s_peak / damping block (results.md, notes, or plot annotations) that a reviewer could resimulate with omc simulate.mos or OMEdit without guessing paths? Answer YES if the model is present and the KPI block is findable; optional notes must be accurate if present. Deleted model, KPIs only spoken, or cannot resimulate from the workspace = NO. YES = full points; NO or unclear = 0.
